name: iCalendar library for GNU Emacs (Emacs Lisp RFC5545 implementation)

mentions.name: iCalendar library for GNU Emacs (Emacs Lisp RFC5545 implementation)
mentions.description: An iCalendar/RFC5545 library implemented in Emacs Lisp, submitted as a large patch to GNU Emacs. It adds iCalendar support to Emacs so that core and third-party packages can work with the iCalendar format.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on implementing iCalendar/RFC5545 in Emacs Lisp. I recently submitted a large patch and hope it will be merged in the next couple of months
